sources.title: stagewise-io/stagewise repository
sources.finding: Main repository for the stagewise agentic IDE: 6,836 stars on 2026-11-16, AGPL-3.0 per GitHub, default branch main, not archived.

sources.title: stagewise README at pinned commit
sources.locator: sections About, Use your coding subscription, stagewise Account (sunset), License
sources.finding: Describes an open source agentic IDE with built-in coding agent, browser, BYO keys, listed subscription/provider imports, an account-service sunset at end of November 2026, and AGPLv3 licensing with contact for other uses.

sources.title: Say Hello to Klex Bots (news post)
sources.locator: sections Why we are building Klex Bots; What changes for stagewise
sources.finding: Dated 2026-10-28. Says local agents cannot work 24/7, the team mostly halted work on stagewise, stagewise IDE accounts are being sunset (BYO keys needed after November 2026) and bug fixes continue for the foreseeable future.

sources.title: stagewise browser app changelog
sources.finding: 1.29.0 added external coding agent integrations (ACP), chat archiving and provider usage limits; 1.31.0 removed account-first onboarding; 1.31.1 (2026-11-04) is the pinned release.

sources.title: stagewise pricing
sources.finding: Hobby free with limited access to three models; Individual $20/month (Pro and Ultra grouped) with all models and extra credits; Enterprise custom with SSO (OIDC, SAML), SCIM and optional self-hosted stagewise Cloud. No annual option or credit amounts stated.

sources.title: stagewise homepage
sources.finding: Positions stagewise as an agentic IDE and agent orchestrator running locally; stagewise Account gives preconfigured Cloud Inference; BYOK and custom endpoints supported; open source AGPLv3; no download links or docs on the page.

sources.title: stagewise privacy policy (repo copy)
sources.locator: sections Customer Content, AI Model Interaction, Usage and Analytics, sub-processors, Data Retention
sources.finding: Effective 2026-03-09. Customer content processed ephemerally; multimodal assets stored up to 72 hours in AWS S3; requests routed through Vercel AI Gateway to named inference providers without a zero-retention guarantee; PostHog EU analytics is opt-in.

sources.title: GNU AGPL v3 license file
sources.finding: Repository license is GNU Affero General Public License version 3 (no stated later-version grant in the file).

sources.title: Electron Forge config
sources.locator: makers array: MakerSquirrel, MakerRpm, MakerDeb, MakerDMG, MakerZIP
sources.finding: Desktop installers are built for Windows (Squirrel setup.exe), Linux (deb, rpm) and macOS (DMG, ZIP).

sources.title: Browser release workflow
sources.locator: matrix: macos-26 arm64, macos-26-intel x64, ubuntu-latest x64, windows-latest x64
sources.finding: Release builds cover macOS arm64 and x64, Linux x64 and Windows x64 only; no mobile or web artifact is produced.

sources.title: Repository AGENTS.md
sources.finding: Monorepo layout: apps/browser (Electron main product), apps/stagewise-cli (headless host for extracted agent packages), apps/deprecated-cli (legacy v0.12), website, update-server, agent-core and agent-shell packages. Product is an Electron app.

sources.title: Provider type registry
sources.finding: Registers stagewise cloud, Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Moonshot, Alibaba, DeepSeek, Z.ai, MiniMax, Xiaomi MiMo, Mistral, xAI, coding-plan, custom Anthropic/OpenAI/Google endpoints, Azure, Bedrock, Vertex, Ollama, OpenRouter, codex, codex-stagewise, claude-code and opencode provider types.

sources.title: ACP adapter registry
sources.finding: External coding agents are driven through Agent Client Protocol adapters; the registry contains exactly codex, claude-code and opencode.

sources.title: Claude Code ACP adapter
sources.finding: Launches the user-installed claude executable through the bundled Claude agent ACP adapter; errors if claude is not installed or signed in; ask permissions map from the approval mode.

sources.title: Codex ChatGPT auth reader
sources.finding: Reads the Codex CLI auth.json ChatGPT access token so the built-in stagewise agent can use a ChatGPT subscription via the Codex responses endpoint; asks the user to run codex login first.

sources.title: codex-stagewise harness
sources.finding: Sends built-in-agent requests to chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex with the user ChatGPT bearer token and a Codex CLI originator header.

sources.title: Coding plan definitions
sources.finding: Defines imported provider coding plans (Qwen, MiniMax and others) that unlock a vendor model list with one API key.

sources.title: Ollama provider type
sources.finding: Local Ollama server models are discoverable as a provider type; custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints also exist.

sources.title: Shared types and preferences schema
sources.finding: Users hold a list of provider instances (several of the same type possible) and a privacy.telemetryLevel preference of off, anonymous or full defaulting to anonymous.

sources.title: GitService
sources.finding: The app creates, lists, switches and removes git worktrees and branches itself and detects merged targets; failures include not-git-repo.

sources.title: Git service types
sources.finding: Defines worktree and branch result types and the not-git-repo failure reason, so non-git folders are handled as a distinct case.

sources.title: Chat panel footer worktree controls
sources.finding: The chat footer lets a user prepare a new worktree or branch or switch to an existing worktree before sending work.

sources.title: Worktree setup runner
sources.finding: Runs a per-project worktree setup script (and detected Codex setup) when a worktree is created.

sources.title: Global skills mounts
sources.finding: Skills are mounted from ~/.stagewise/skills, ~/.agents/skills and optionally ~/.codex/skills and ~/.claude/skills; workspace skills come from .stagewise/skills and .agents/skills.

sources.title: Workspace AGENTS.md reader
sources.finding: Reads the workspace-root AGENTS.md into the agent context with a length cap.

sources.title: Bundled plugins and skills
sources.finding: Bundled plugins: figma, github, javascript-sandbox, mini-apps, posthog, remotion, supabase, vercel. Bundled skills: debug, implement, learn-skill, plan, preview, watch.

sources.title: Plugin metadata schema
sources.finding: Plugins are directories with metadata.json (name, description, required credential types) plus skills; credentials come from the product credential registry.

sources.title: Credential type registry
sources.finding: Credential types exist for GitHub, Figma, Vercel, Supabase, PostHog and Google AI personal access tokens used by plugins.

sources.title: Internal stagewise MCP server
sources.finding: The only MCP surface is a private stdio server handed to external ACP agents so they can show a native question form; no user MCP server configuration or exported control tools.

sources.title: ACP runtime
sources.finding: Session start passes only the internal stagewise MCP server and resumes persisted ACP sessions when the adapter supports it.

sources.title: Agent memory persistence
sources.finding: Chat history is written to per-agent memory snapshots (jsonl/markdown) on post-step, compression and message events, with a global memory index.

sources.title: Plan markdown parsing
sources.finding: Plans are markdown documents with a heading-derived name parsed into structured sections used by the plan viewer.

sources.title: Agent persistence database
sources.finding: Agent history, envelopes and approvals persist in a local libsql database, so chats reload after restart.

sources.title: AgentManager
sources.finding: Manages many agent instances at once, supports side chats cloned from a source chat, and exposes lifecycle notification hooks.

sources.title: Tool approval modes
sources.finding: Shell and sandbox tool approval modes are alwaysAsk (default), alwaysAllow and smart.

sources.title: Smart approval classifier prompt
sources.finding: In smart mode an LLM classifier decides whether a shell command needs approval, flagging out-of-workspace writes, global installs, outbound data, destructive git and privilege escalation.

sources.title: Diff history spec
sources.finding: Tracks per-agent file edits with before/after so changes can be reviewed and reverted from the chat.

sources.title: Revert confirmation popover
sources.finding: Chat messages offer a confirmed revert of the agent file changes made after that message.

sources.title: BaseAgent
sources.finding: Agents emit done, question and error events, queue user messages while busy, support maxSteps and maxRetries config and stop handling.

sources.title: Notification sounds service
sources.finding: Agent done, question and error events trigger desktop notification sounds.

sources.title: Model fallback manager
sources.finding: On upstream overload errors (429, 502, 503, 529) a preset advances to the next fallback model for 5 minutes.

sources.title: Provider type interface
sources.finding: Provider types can expose current subscription usage limits, shown in the app since 1.29.0; no per-task monetary cost is recorded.

sources.title: TelemetryService
sources.finding: Uses PostHog (EU host by default) gated by privacy.telemetryLevel; LLM tracing only at the full level.

sources.title: Account settings telemetry control
sources.finding: Settings expose a telemetry level control writing privacy.telemetryLevel.

sources.title: stagewise-cli README
sources.finding: MVP headless CLI mounts a workspace, sends one prompt to a chat agent and prints the answer; uses ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and alwaysAllow approvals.

sources.title: stagewise-cli package.json
sources.finding: Package @stagewise/stagewise-cli version 0.0.0 is marked private, so it is not published.

sources.title: Deprecated CLI package.json
sources.finding: The legacy npm stagewise-cli 0.12.0 is deprecated in favor of the desktop app.

sources.title: Onboarding screens
sources.finding: First run walks through provider configuration, skills and theme before use.

sources.title: Shell tool directory
sources.finding: The agent runs shell commands through a PTY-backed shell tool in the user environment.

sources.title: Mount manager
sources.locator: mounts with permissions, git worktree watcher
sources.finding: Workspaces are mounted with permission flags and watched, including linked git worktrees.

sources.title: JavaScript sandbox service
sources.finding: A JS sandbox runs in an Electron utility process with mounted file access and diff capture; it is a scripting tool, not a container.

sources.title: LSP service
sources.finding: Language-server diagnostics feed a get-linting-diagnostics tool for the agent.

sources.title: Library docs search tool
sources.finding: The agent can list and search library documentation as external knowledge.

sources.title: Browser tools
sources.finding: The agent can read tab console logs and run sandboxed JS against browser tabs.

sources.title: askUserQuestions tool
sources.finding: The agent can pause to ask structured questions that the user answers in the UI.

sources.title: Sidebar agents list
sources.locator: agent list with archive/resume and worktree grouping
sources.finding: The sidebar lists chats grouped by workspace/worktree with archive and resume actions.

sources.title: Bundled GitHub plugin skill
sources.locator: Capabilities list (issues, pull requests, actions, releases) and Making Requests section
sources.finding: The product-bundled GitHub plugin skill tells the agent it can create, read, update and comment on issues, and create, list, review and merge pull requests through the GitHub REST API with a stored personal access token fetched inside the JS sandbox.

sources.title: stagewise-io/stagewise stagewise@1.31.1: apps/browser/src/shared/karton-contracts/ui/shared-types.ts
sources.finding: telemetryLevel is an enum of off, anonymous and full with default anonymous; apps/browser/src/ui/screens/settings/sections/account-section.tsx renders the TelemetrySetting control that changes it.

sources.title: stagewise TelemetryService.capture at 1.31.1
sources.locator: capture(): bypassOptOut list and level check, lines 1044-1055
sources.finding: When telemetryLevel is off, capture() still sends the bypassOptOut events app-launched, telemetry-level-changed, onboarding-completed, experience-survey-answered, experience-survey-feedback-submitted, experience-founder-call-survey-opened and experience-founder-call-survey-dismissed to PostHog; a code comment says this measures opt-out rates and keeps funnels intact.

sources.title: stagewise privacy policy source at 1.31.1
sources.locator: Usage & Analytics Data, lines 64-65; Cookies, line 127
sources.finding: The privacy policy says PostHog usage and analytics data is collected depending on the user's opt-in configuration and subject to cookie consent, with consent as the legal basis; this conflicts with the app schema default telemetryLevel anonymous.
